reviewNotes: Reviewed every one of 418 exported speech keys from 100 cards against data/real-conversation-400-1.json vocabulary readings and furigana. Sentence/cloze prompts and full-sentence correct-answer explanations use 1.0; individual words and short choice groups use 0.85. Topic/contrast は -> わ checked by exact key and occurrence, including では and short 最近は/普通は/最後は/途中は choices. Lexical はなす/はなせます/はなしましょう/はなしかた, はる, はっせい, はじめて, はんたい and しゅくはく retained. Directional へ -> え only in station/Osaka/family-home/bank/Tokyo-direction sentence prompts; lexical へんこう, しゅうへん, へや and このへん retained. All を are object particles -> お. Corrected explanation readings 外国人 from がいこくにん to がいこくじん and 道 from どう to みち using each card’s accepted vocabulary reading and context. Katakana converted to hiragana with long vowels/gemination preserved (こんびに, れぽーと, ちぇっくいん, ほてる, ほーむ). Added final punctuation to fragments. Display labels and lookup keys unchanged. Text review only; audible articulation and pitch accent not verified.
